prompt:
Implement this service.

<spec>
name: alert-rule-evaluator
description: Stores threshold alert rules and evaluates submitted metric values against
  them.
endpoints:
- method: GET
  path: /health
- method: GET
  path: /metrics
- method: POST
  path: /rules
  description: 'body {name: non-empty, metric: non-empty, op: ">" or "<", threshold:
    number}; 201; 400 for any invalid field or malformed JSON; 409 if name exists'
- method: GET
  path: /rules
  description: 200 JSON list of rules
- method: POST
  path: /evaluate
  description: 'body {metric: string, value: number}; 200 {firing: [rule names]} listing
    every rule for that metric whose condition (value op threshold) holds, sorted
    by name; 400 if metric or value missing'
metrics:
- name: alert_rules
  type: gauge
  help: Defined rules
- name: alerts_firing
  type: gauge
  help: Rules firing in the most recent evaluation
- name: alert_evaluations_total
  type: counter
  help: Evaluations performed
behaviors:
- Rules for other metrics are ignored during evaluation
probes:
- method: POST
  path: /rules
  expect_status:
  - 201
  body: '{"name": "hot", "metric": "temp", "op": ">", "threshold": 80}'
- method: POST
  path: /rules
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"name": "bad", "metric": "temp", "op": "=", "threshold": 1}'
- method: POST
  path: /rules
  expect_status:
  - 409
  body: '{"name": "hot", "metric": "temp", "op": ">", "threshold": 80}'
- method: POST
  path: /evaluate
  expect_status:
  - 200
  body: '{"metric": "temp", "value": 95}'
- method: POST
  path: /evaluate
  expect_status:
  - 400
  body: '{"metric": "temp"}'
</spec>

Already provided by templates (do NOT write or register these):
- main.go: `func newServer() http.Handler` serves GET /health and GET /metrics, then calls
  `registerRoutes(mux)`. Do not register /health or /metrics yourself.
- metrics.go: Prometheus variables you must keep up to date from your handlers:
- alertRules  (gauge) -> exposed as `alert_rules`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add
- alertsFiring  (gauge) -> exposed as `alerts_firing`; use Set/Inc/Dec/Add
- alertEvaluationsTotal  (counter) -> exposed as `alert_evaluations_total`; use Inc/Add

You must write these files:
1. handlers.go - defines `func registerRoutes(mux *http.ServeMux)` that registers ONLY these routes:
   - POST /rules  body {name: non-empty, metric: non-empty, op: ">" or "<", threshold: number}; 201; 400 for any invalid field or malformed JSON; 409 if name exists
   - GET /rules  200 JSON list of rules
   - POST /evaluate  body {metric: string, value: number}; 200 {firing: [rule names]} listing every rule for that metric whose condition (value op threshold) holds, sorted by name; 400 if metric or value missing
   Keep state in memory (you may add store.go). Return JSON with proper status codes; reject
   malformed input with 400. The behaviors in the spec are verified at runtime.
2. handlers_test.go - at least 3 `func TestXxx(t *testing.T)` functions using
   net/http/httptest against `newServer()`. Never bind real ports; tests must finish in seconds.
3. README.md - must contain: an "## Endpoints" section listing EVERY spec endpoint (including
   /health and /metrics) as `METHOD /path` in backticks, and a "## Metrics" section listing EVERY
   metric name in backticks. Only document things that actually exist.
